_about: Tools for founders and investors: tools.html (the hub) and one page per tool, tool-<slug>.html. Each tool's working part is tools/toolkit/pages/<slug>.html; its behaviour is in js/main.js (initTools). 'soon': listed on the hub as coming soon, with no page yet.

tools.name: Round finder
tools.summary: Seven yes-or-no questions to find which round you are really raising, and what it usually raises in India.
tools.lede: Round names are a shorthand for what you have proven, not for how much you want. Answer honestly: your first “not yet” is roughly where you are.
tools.seo: Round Finder: Which Round Are You Raising?

tools.name: Pre-money and post-money calculator
tools.summary: Enter what you are raising and the valuation. See the investor’s stake, the share price and how many new shares you issue.
tools.lede: The same headline number means a different stake depending on whether it is pre-money or post-money. Work out exactly what you are giving away.

tools.name: Dilution simulator
tools.summary: Add up to four rounds and an ESOP pool, and watch every holder’s percentage, and the value of the founders’ stake, change.
tools.lede: Every round shrinks your percentage. Whether it also grows your value depends on the price. Model your rounds before you sign the first one.

tools.name: Runway calculator
tools.summary: Cash in the bank, monthly costs and revenue: how many months you have left, and the latest date to start raising.
tools.lede: Runway is the clearest measure of how much time you have to build, change course or raise. Know your number, and start raising well before it runs out.

tools.name: Exit waterfall
tools.summary: Who gets what when the company is sold, with 1x or 2x and participating preferences.

tools.name: ESOP pool sizer
tools.summary: Size your option pool from your hiring plan, and see what it costs the founders.

tools.name: Return calculator
tools.summary: Cheque size, exit value and years held: the multiple and IRR, after later rounds dilute you.

tools.name: Pro-rata cost
tools.summary: What it costs to keep your percentage in the next round.
